meta.name: paid-ads-tiktok
meta.description: Audit, diagnose, and safely operate connected TikTok Ads accounts through the NotFair MCP. Use for TikTok advertising, Spark Ads, short-form video ads, campaign or ad-group analysis, spend, conversions, targeting, creative, budgets, bids, creator briefs, campaign setup, or approved TikTok Ads changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 诊断并调整 TikTok 广告投放,管好预算、出价与素材
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在跑 TikTok 广告,想查花费、转化和出价哪里不对
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and adjust TikTok ad campaigns, tuning budgets, bids, and creative
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run TikTok ads and want to see where spend, conversions, and bids went wrong

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过 NotFair MCP 连上你的 TikTok Ads 账户，用实时数据诊断投放（花费、转化、定向、素材、预算、出价），并在你确认后执行改动。
howto.when: 当你提到 TikTok 广告、Spark Ads 等关键词，或要分析 campaign/ad group 表现、调整预算出价时触发。

say.text: 看一下我 TikTok 广告账户最近 7 天的花费和转化
say.note: 它会拉取该时间窗的投放数据。

say.text: 这个 campaign 的 CPA 变高了，帮我诊断最可能的原因
say.note: 输出数据支持的判断，区分事实与推测。

say.text: 把这组广告预算从 50 美元改成 80 美元，先给我看预览
say.note: 先展示改动预览，等你确认再执行。

howto.what_en: Once installed, it connects to your TikTok Ads account via the NotFair MCP, diagnoses delivery from live data (spend, conversions, targeting, creative, budgets, bids), and applies changes only after you approve them.
howto.when_en: Use when you work on TikTok advertising, Spark Ads, or short-form video ads — campaign or ad-group analysis, spend and conversions, budgets, bids, or approved account changes.

say_en.text: Look at the last 7 days of spend and conversions in my TikTok Ads account
say_en.note: It pulls delivery data for that window.

say_en.text: CPA on this campaign went up - diagnose the most likely cause
Change this ad group's budget from $50 to $80, show a preview first
say_en.note: Previews, then waits for your approval.
